GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (11 Nov 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 266)
11 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Chinese and Korean Nationals
1. Transmitted herewith for information are lists of chinese and Korean Nationals located in the vicinity of UTSUNOMIYA, whom the Commanding General, English Army has recommended for repatriation at an early date.
2. It is desired that you return this personnel to their respective countries in accordance with the provisions of Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese government, file AG 370.5 (1 Nov 45) GC, dated 1 November 1945, subject: "Repatriation of Non-Japanese from Japan." No special priority should be given this group.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
2. Incls:
Incl 1 - Manifests Chinese
Incl 2 - Manifests Koreans
